page.layout: One column of running text, no marginal notes. Printed page 180, running head "De Juramenti Obligatione" at top. Catchword "siquis" at the lower right.

main_text.l: que qui jus non habet exigendi juramen-
tum; vel qui sine justâ causâ nos adigit
ad jurandum, aut rem indebitam petit,
aut ex aliquâ simili causâ rationabili. Sed
præterquam quòd primo ista ab eis gra-
tis dicuntur, sine ulla aut Scripturæ aut
veteris Ecclesiæ authoritate, vel etiam
solidâ & evidenti ratione: nec tollitur
secundò, sed nec minuitur istâ restricti-
one vis eorum argumentorum, quæ jam
adduximus in contrarium: sciendum ter-
tiò, etsi injusta vis concederetur impe-
dire posse obligationem illam quæ ho-
mini fit, quia non est æquum ut ex actu
injusto jus sibi quis acquirat, nullam ta-
men injuriam ab hominibus illatam ju-
stam nobis causam præbere posse inju-
riam faciendi Deo, tollendo sc. illam obl-
igationem, quæ Deo fit ut cordium in-
spectori; cui, ex omni juramento no-
stro propter nominis sui invocationem, j-
us accrescit. Quarto, denique, Iesuitica
hæc doctrina improbis hominibus pro
sua libidine, mentiendi & pejerandi li-
centiam facit: etiam illâ restrictione non
obstante: quum eâ manente, adhuc ta-
men an expediat vel non expediat uti
æquivocatione, penes ipsum jurantem
solum sit tota judicandi potestas. Ideo

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "sine", "justâ", "solidâ", "sciendum"). The dark strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Italic words are marked: primo, secundò, tertiò, Quarto. "Quarto" is also underlined in print. "ho-mini" and "no-stro" are split at line ends and rejoined with their printed hyphens; "in-spectori" likewise.
